snippet.title: Beachside Cafe Simulator - Beta Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Run your own dessert restaurant in a French beach town! Cook crepes, waffles, ice cream and more. Serve tourists and locals, and expand your menu. Manage supplies, hire employees, upgrade your equipment, and grow your space to build your dream seaside dessert spot.

Register for the beta now: https://dashboard.mailerlite.com/forms/907799/160589355983832834/share
